results.title: Gartner analyst: Supply chain leaders are being asked to do two jobs at once - Logistics Management
results.content: LM    Topics     Logistics    3PL    Gartner. Speaking during the opening keynote at the Gartner Supply Chain Symposium in Orlando, Lindsay Azim, Senior Director, Analyst in Gartner's Supply Chain and Procurement Management practice, said companies are under pressure to keep goods moving and costs under control today, while also preparing for a future shaped by artificial intelligence that is still taking form. At the same time, many companies are still trying to figure out what real value those investments will deliver. Supply chain organizations spent an average of $24 million on AI in 2025, but many projects have gone over budget and are not expected to produce results for at least a year, Azim said. Today, the focus has shifted to how AI will change the way supply chains operate. 2026 Technology Roundtable: The next phase of supply chain technology. AI’s energy appetite is emerging as a supply chain risk, notes Gartner. ### May 2026 Logistics Management.

results.title: Making self-funding supply chains real - Logistics Management
results.content: Accenture’s “Making Self-Funding Supply Chains Real” research shows organizations put the biggest supply chain cost drivers under the microscope, across planning, procurement, manufacturing and fulfillment. Essentially, they turn AI adoption into a self-funding engine for supply chain transformation. ## A cost-optimization framework for self-funding supply chains. Organizations can then reinvest saved costs to build fully connected, AI-enabled supply chain ecosystems. For example, AI agents can monitor supply chain disruptions, recommend alternative sourcing strategies, and automate replenishment decisions in real time. Control towers provide the real-time monitoring and analytics capabilities that supply chain leaders need to be able to, for example, reduce delays and optimize inventory levels. As supply chain leaders use the cost-optimization framework to identify where to focus their investments, they should tie every AI initiative to clear business objectives around productivity, service delivery, resilience and cost savings. A self-funding supply chain also needs a scalable operating model: focus on the biggest opportunities, build AI into daily decisions, and train teams to work with and supervise more autonomous processes.
